intro: Popular Story Mode mods for GTA V Legacy (GTA5.exe), mostly from GTA5-Mods.com. Script Hook V comes first, and every mod that needs it stops working after a game patch until Script Hook V is updated. Story Mode only: never launch GTA Online with mods installed.

mods.name: Script Hook V + Native Trainer
mods.summary: Alexander Blade's script loader. Nearly every script and trainer needs it, and each game patch breaks it until it's updated.
mods.note: Copy ScriptHookV.dll and the bundled ASI loader (dinput8.dll) next to GTA5.exe. It closes the game if you go into GTA Online.

mods.name: OpenIV
mods.summary: Archive editor and mod installer for Legacy. Its OpenIV.asi lets replacement mods load from a separate mods folder.
mods.note: Use Tools › ASI Manager to install OpenIV.ASI, and only edit files inside the mods folder, never the originals.

mods.name: Community Script Hook V .NET
mods.summary: Runs .NET (C#) scripts from the scripts folder. Most Legacy C# mods target it.
mods.note: Install Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8 and the Visual C++ redistributable first, as its page explains.

mods.name: LemonUI
mods.summary: Menu library many SHVDN scripts use for their menus. Install it if a mod lists it as required.

mods.name: Simple Trainer
mods.summary: Long-running trainer: spawn vehicles and peds, change weather and time, teleport, and save outfits.

mods.name: Menyoo 2.0
mods.summary: Trainer and map editor: spawn and place objects, edit outfits, and build scenes for screenshots.
mods.note: Use the Menyoo 2.0 listing; the old Menyoo PC page is no longer maintained.

mods.name: Enhanced Native Trainer
mods.summary: Community-updated Enhanced Native Trainer with vehicle, ped, weapon and world options.

mods.name: Packfile Limit Adjuster
mods.summary: Doubles how many RPF archives the game can load. Fixes ERR_FIL_PACK_1 crashes, nothing else.

mods.name: HeapAdjuster
mods.summary: Fixes ERR_MEM_EMBEDDEDALLOC_ALLOC crashes from heavy modding by letting you set a bigger heap in its ini.

mods.name: Weapon Limits Adjuster
mods.summary: Raises the weapons.meta and weapon-component limits so add-on weapon packs don't crash while loading.

mods.name: fwBoxStreamerVariable patch
mods.summary: Stops parts of the map and LODs vanishing when many map mods are installed, and can raise the decal limit.

mods.name: Add-On Vehicle Spawner
mods.summary: Finds the add-on vehicles you've installed and lists them in a menu to spawn, with search and sorting.

mods.name: Enable All Interiors
mods.summary: Opens interiors across the map in Story Mode, replacing older mods such as Open All Interiors.
